
  # Release Rust package to crates.io
  release-rust:
    needs: detect
    if: needs.detect.outputs.language == 'rust'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      
      - name: Install Rust
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
      
      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          cd rust-compressor
          cargo test
      
      - name: Build release
        run: |
          cd rust-compressor
          cargo build --release
      
      - name: Publish to crates.io
        run: |
          cd rust-compressor
          cargo publish
        env:
          CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CARGO_TOKEN }}
      
      - name: Create GitHub Release
        uses: actions/create-release@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ github.ref }}
          release_name: Rust v${{ needs.detect.outputs.version }}
          body: |
            Rust ASON Compressor v${{ needs.detect.outputs.version }}
            
            Install: Add to Cargo.toml: `ason-compressor = "${{ needs.detect.outputs.version }}"`
            
            Documentation: https://docs.rs/ason-compressor
